title: Cosmological constraints on the excited state: BBN, CMB and the chi2 -> chi1 transition for delta ~ 300 keV
question: For pseudo-Dirac DM with delta = 200-400 keV and m = 0.3-4 TeV, what excited fraction f2 survives freeze-out, how fast does chi2 decay or down-scatter, and is the released energy f2 delta constrained by BBN, CMB spectral distortions, CMB anisotropies, the 300 keV sky or the exothermic requirement?
